nodes.title: GuidancePositive
widgets_values:
Fourpanel comics,manga,colored

Panel 1 (Top Left):
A bright, sunny day in a small town park,A cheerful, young girl with short brown hair wearing a yellow dress, holding a red balloon,The girl is smiling and looking at the balloon.A text buddle on her head says:"What a beautiful day!"

Panel 2 (Top Right):
The same park, a gentle breeze blows,The same girl, still holding the balloon, but the balloon is starting to lift,The girl looks surprised as the balloon starts to float away,A text buddle on her head says:"Oh no, my balloon!"

Panel 3 (Bottom Left):
The balloon is high up in the sky, floating away,The girl looks up, worried, and a friendly dog with a leash appears beside her,The dog is jumping up, trying to reach the balloon. text buddle on her head says:"Can you catch it, boy?"

Panel 4 (Bottom Right):
The dog successfully catches the string of the balloon in mid-air,The girl smiles widely, holding the balloon again, and the dog sits happily beside her.The girl pats the dog on the head.text buddle on her head says:"Thank you, you're the best!"

nodes.title: Making360Photos
widgets_values:
1.Chnage this to Your Custom Path
Like change the C:\Users\dseditor\Desktop\100\exiftool-12.96_64 to C:\Output
2.Go to the path folder
Find the jpg like input_00001.jpg
3.Get EXIFtools
https://exiftool.org/
4.In windows put the exe in the same dir as jpg files ,open the cmd windows and type
.\exiftool -xmp:ProjectionType=equirectangular -xmp:UsePanoramaViewer=True input_00001.jpg
5.Your 360 image is ready for facebook
